notes: Found via the top-nav flyout link '/lagerraeumung' (Lagerraeumung = warehouse clearance/liquidation) and the homepage's repeated 'Lagerschnaeppchen' promo tiles. The /lagerraeumung hub page (page title 'Moebel Abverkauf & Lagerraeumungsverkauf online') is itself a type:filteredURLs landing page with articleCount:0 - not a product listing - but its on-page copy is explicit permanent-markdown/outlet-style clearance language, not a temporary campaign: 'Um Platz fuer neue Kollektionen zu schaffen, bieten wir eine breite Auswahl an stark reduzierten Ausstellungsstuecken und Restposten - aber nur solange der Vorrat reicht!' (To make room for new collections we offer heavily reduced showroom pieces and remaining/discontinued stock - while supplies last). This matches the brief's Restposten/Ausstellungsstuecke clearance signal, not a Sale/percent-off campaign. The hub organizes the clearance inventory into two site-labelled groups (H2 headings) - 'Moebel Abverkauf' (Furniture Clearance) and 'Deko & Haushalt Abverkauf' (Decor and Household Clearance) - each a grid of tiles linking to an ordinary category URL with the site's own clearance-offer facet appended, offerType_s=AbverkaufsPreis (=clearance price), plus categorySortBy=priceAsc. Verified this facet is genuinely filtering (not ignored): unfiltered /sofas reports 1227 products vs 13 with the clearance filter; unfiltered /geschirr reports 991 vs 5 filtered. Fetched all 15 tiles' filtered URLs directly and read each page's own rendered 'N Ergebnisse' count as qty evidence. One tile (Teppiche/Rugs) returned the site's own zero-results message ('Die getroffene Auswahl sorgt dafuer, dass keine Produkte angezeigt werden koennen...') so it was dropped per the zero-listing rule, not emitted as qty 0. Also checked and excluded two adjacent candidates: /angebote ('Top-Angebote, Sale & Outlet-Moebel') is a generic, explicitly recurring promotional/coupon/weekly-ad marketing page ('regelmaessig wechselnde Rabattaktionen', voucher campaigns, Prospekt/Werbung) with no product grid of its own and no permanence signal - classic generic Sale, excluded per the Sale-vs-Clearance rule. /outlet-moebelhaus ('Hoeffner Outlet') is a physical-store-visit discount promotion (35% + additional 10% with customer card, in-store only) with no online product listing at all - excluded as not a PLP. No ambiguous rows were left unresolved.
